flows.name: Discover the studio on the landing page
flows.goal: Understand what the studio sells and how to order, and start shopping.
flows.outcome: Nothing is stored; the shopper knows pickup, shipping and pay-later terms and the catalog is one action away after a refresh.
flows.description: A visitor arrives on the public landing page and the website explains what Mitti Studio sells in small batches, how guest ordering works without messaging, free Jaipur studio pickup versus Rs.99 courier with free courier over Rs.1,500, and pay-later-by-UPI, then offers a start-shopping entry that leads to the live catalog.

flows.name: Browse catalog with live stock
flows.goal: Browse live pieces and find what is still available.
flows.outcome: No data is changed; the shopper has seen current products and stock states that persist after a refresh.
flows.description: The shopper opens the public catalog and the website shows products with photos, piece type, description, glaze and size options, price and honest live stock with Almost Gone flags and disabled Sold Out variants, and the shopper narrows the list by piece type Mug, Bowl, Planter, Vase and by in-stock versus sold-out.

flows.name: Place a guest pickup or courier order
flows.goal: Order chosen pieces as a guest without messaging.
preconditions: At least one variant in stock.
flows.outcome: An Order is stored as New and Unpaid with items, fulfillment, discount and totals and variant stock is reduced; confirmation and order details remain after a refresh.
flows.description: The shopper chooses an in-stock glaze and size variant and quantity, picks free studio pickup or courier, optionally adds one weekend discount code validated against its dates, enters name, phone and courier address when needed, and places the order; the website enforces zero-stock blocking, Rs.99 courier with free courier when the total after discount reaches Rs.1,500 and always-free pickup, decrements stock, and shows a confirmation with pay-by-UPI-later instructions.

flows.name: Studio owner sign up
flows.outcome: The owner account exists and the owner is signed in; refresh keeps her signed in.
flows.description: A new studio owner creates the single shop account with email and password and the website signs her in so she can manage products, orders and discount codes.

flows.name: Studio owner sign in
flows.goal: Sign in to manage the shop.
flows.outcome: The owner is signed in and sees her shop workspace; refresh keeps her signed in.
flows.description: The studio owner returns with email and password and the website signs her in to her own products, orders and codes.

flows.name: Studio owner sign out
flows.outcome: The session is ended; refresh shows public pages and owner pages require sign-in again.
flows.description: The signed-in studio owner chooses to sign out and the website ends the session and returns to public pages.

flows.name: View and fulfill orders
flows.goal: See new orders and move them through packing, dispatch and payment.
flows.outcome: Order status and payment state changes are stored and stock is restored on cancel; the updated newest-first list remains after a refresh.
flows.description: The signed-in owner opens the order list newest first and the website shows items, fulfillment type, totals, discount used and Unpaid or Paid state with counts, lets her find orders by status, and lets her mark an order Packed then Shipped for courier or Picked Up for pickup, mark UPI Paid after collecting, and Cancel with stock restore.

flows.name: Create a product with variants
flows.goal: Add a new piece with its glaze and size options.
flows.outcome: A Product with its Variants is stored and appears in the shopper catalog; it is still there after a refresh.
flows.description: The signed-in owner creates a new product listing with name, piece type, description and photos plus one or more glaze and size variants each with price and stock count, and the website validates the photo preview and publishes the listing to the public catalog with live stock.

flows.name: Edit a product and its variants
flows.goal: Keep listings, prices and stock counts correct.
flows.outcome: Product and Variant changes are stored and the updated listing and stock states remain after a refresh.
flows.description: The signed-in owner finds a product in her catalog list, updates its name, description, photos, piece type and its variants glaze, size, price and stock counts, and the website saves the changes and refreshes live stock flags including Almost Gone and Sold Out in the shopper catalog.

flows.name: Archive a product
flows.goal: Remove a piece from sale without losing order history.
flows.outcome: The product is archived and absent from the public catalog but past orders are unchanged; the state persists after a refresh.
flows.description: The signed-in owner chooses to archive a product she no longer sells and confirms, and the website hides it from the shopper catalog while leaving past orders that contain it unchanged.

flows.name: Manage discount codes
flows.outcome: DiscountCode records are created, updated or deleted; the current list and their validity remain after a refresh.
flows.description: The signed-in owner opens the discount-code list and creates, edits and deletes weekend codes with code value, percent off and start and end dates, and the website validates dates and makes valid codes usable once per guest order at checkout.

flows.name: View low-glaze warnings
flows.goal: Know which glazes are nearly gone.
flows.outcome: Nothing is changed; the low-stock list with current counts is still shown after a refresh until stock changes.
flows.description: The signed-in owner opens the low-stock view and the website lists variants with 3 or fewer units left with their product, glaze, size and remaining count so she can plan the next batch.

fields.label: Product name
fields.meaning: How the studio and shoppers refer to the piece listing

fields.label: Piece type
fields.meaning: Grouping of the piece as Mug, Bowl, Planter or Vase

fields.label: Product description
fields.meaning: What the piece is, how it is made and how it looks
fields.example: Hand-thrown stoneware mug with speckled glaze, 300 ml.

fields.label: Product photo
fields.meaning: Photo of the piece that shoppers see; validated and previewed before saving

fields.label: Glaze
fields.meaning: Colour/finish option of the variant

fields.label: Size
fields.meaning: Size or capacity option of the variant

fields.label: Variant price
fields.meaning: Price in rupees for one unit of this glaze-plus-size variant

fields.label: Variant stock count
fields.meaning: How many units of this variant are left and can be sold

fields.label: Quantity
fields.meaning: How many units of the chosen variant the shopper wants, limited by live stock

fields.label: Fulfillment choice
fields.meaning: Whether the shopper picks up free at the Jaipur studio or pays for courier

fields.label: Discount code entered
fields.meaning: Optional weekend code the shopper types at checkout for percent off

fields.label: Shopper name
fields.meaning: Who the guest order belongs to for packing and contact

fields.label: Shopper phone
fields.meaning: Phone number to contact the shopper about pickup or courier and UPI collection

fields.label: Courier address
fields.meaning: Delivery address, required only when fulfillment choice is Courier

fields.label: Code value
fields.meaning: Short code shared on Instagram that shoppers type at checkout

fields.label: Discount percent
fields.meaning: Percent off the items total when the code is valid

fields.label: Discount start date
fields.meaning: First day the code can be used

fields.label: Discount end date
fields.meaning: Last day the code can be used

fields.label: Owner email
fields.meaning: Email the studio owner uses to sign in

fields.label: Owner password
fields.meaning: Secret that protects the owner account

fields.label: Availability filter
fields.meaning: Shopper filter to show in-stock pieces versus sold-out pieces

fields.label: Order status filter
fields.meaning: Owner filter to find orders by New, Packed, Shipped, Picked Up or Cancelled

fields.label: Piece type filter
fields.meaning: Shopper filter to show pieces of one piece type or all piece types

steps.websiteResponse: The website asks to confirm the deletion and says what else will be removed with it.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website deletes the record and what belongs to it.
Nothing is deleted; the record stays as it was.

assumptions.text: Archived products are hidden from the shopper catalog but past orders keep their product, variant, price and quantity details unchanged.
Owner order list is newest first; order total is items total minus percent discount plus courier fee per the Rs.99 / free over Rs.1,500 rule.
Product photos are validated as images and previewed before saving and kept for the session per file-upload simulation; no external storage is implied.

questions.question: Can one guest order contain multiple different glaze/size variants?
questions.whyItMatters: Determines whether checkout supports a basket of items versus a single variant and how totals and stock checks work.
questions.defaultAnswer: Yes - one order can contain multiple variants and quantities; stock is checked per variant.
